sector: Pharma & Bulk Drugs (pharmaceuticals, APIs/bulk drugs, biologics manufacturing)
method: WebSearch for discovery across multiple query angles (foreign pharma India investment, API/bulk drug manufacturer plant announcements, biologics manufacturing expansion, pharma JVs), followed by WebFetch to open and read each candidate source directly before inclusion. Every finding below was verified by opening at least one substantive article/press release (not a search snippet). Non-Indian-HQ companies only. Session's WebSearch quota was exhausted partway through (after ~15 queries), which capped further discovery angles (Otsuka/Takeda/Teva/Viatris, GSK vaccines, Merck/Pfizer/Roche, Bulk Drug Park foreign tenants were queued but not run) rather than any change in method or standards.

findings.signal: Announced a $1 billion+ multi-year investment to build a new contract-manufacturing oversight and quality hub in Hyderabad, expanding capacity for diabetes, obesity, Alzheimer's, cancer, and autoimmune medicines; follows Lilly's August 2025 opening of a Global Capability Centre in the same city. Stated by Patrik Jonsson, President of Lilly International, in a company statement.

Foreign JV partner (51% stake, Laurus Labs 49%) in Krka Pharma Pvt. Ltd., Hyderabad; approved fresh capital tranches during the sweep window to fund a new finished-dosage/biopharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Genome Valley -- Rs 833 crore (Laurus) + Rs 867 crore (Krka) approved by Laurus Labs' board on 6 March 2025 for land/facility setup, followed by a further EUR 9.8m (Laurus) + EUR 10.2m (Krka) tranche approved 30 April 2026 for the manufacturing facility capex, maintaining the 51:49 ratio.

Inaugurated new parenteral development and sterility laboratories at its Bengaluru Center of Excellence, expanding sterile/injectable (solutions, suspensions, lyophilized powder) formulation-development and testing capabilities as part of a broader strategic investment in its India site.

negative_notes.reason_excluded: The widely-reported $437m/EUR400m Hyderabad investment (announced 17 Jul 2024, so also outside the ~18-month window) is explicitly for a Global Capacity Centre -- a digital/business-operations and workforce hub (target headcount 1,000 -> 2,600) -- not a manufacturing, API/bulk-drug, or biologics plant. Confirmed via Fierce Pharma coverage: the GCC will 'grow the site's digital team and utilize artificial intelligence tools' for 'value accretive activities', with no manufacturing scope described. Excluded as sector-mismatch (not a manufacturing/bulk-drug investment) and as stale (pre-dates the sweep window).

Real, recent (2025-26) INR 2,500-3,000 crore Maharashtra (Patalganga) investment commitment, but Novonesis is an industrial-biotech/enzymes company (formed from the Novozymes/Chr. Hansen merger) supplying enzymes, yeast and biological inputs for biofuels, food, agriculture, and household-care industries -- not a pharmaceutical, API/bulk-drug, or biologics manufacturer. Excluded as sector-mismatch, not a data-quality problem with the finding itself.

negative_notes.company: Novartis India (stake sale to ChrysCapital-led consortium)
negative_notes.reason_excluded: This is Novartis divesting a controlling (70.68%) stake in its existing Indian listed subsidiary to a domestic private-equity-led consortium (completed 29 Jul 2026) -- an ownership change of a decades-old India entity, not new foreign capital or capacity entering India. Does not represent a fresh investment signal for the twin.

negative_notes.country_of_headquarters: South Korea (Samsung Biologics); PolyPeptide is Swiss-headquartered
negative_notes.reason_excluded: Coverage of Samsung Biologics' ~$1.8bn acquisition offer for PolyPeptide Group mentions PolyPeptide already operates a cGMP facility in India among five countries, but no source found describes this as a new India-specific investment, expansion, or commitment -- it is a global corporate acquisition where the India facility is incidental, pre-existing infrastructure. Left out for lack of a substantive India-specific investment signal, not ruled out as false.
